budget_scope: SDK-admitted queued, executing and unconsumed-result variable payloads; fixed record storage is bounded by item/handle counts. Caller memory and transient backend encoding buffers are separate.
state_overflow: coalesce-latest and release replaced payload; aggregate byte overflow rejects before admission
event_overflow: ResourceExhausted before ownership transfer; no silent drops
operation_result: single consumer; AlreadyConsumed on a second successful retrieval attempt

cancellation.wait: drop only this wait registration; operation remains engine-owned
cancellation.work: requestCancel skips queued invocation or discards an executing callback's late result; it does not interrupt foreign synchronous code or roll back effects
cancellation.observation: requestStop gates new callback entry; awaitStopped waits queued tickets, executing callback and foreign reference cleanup

ownership.objects: UniFFI backend references; no duplicate public handle registry
ownership.queued_callback: source lease exists before enqueue and persists through cleanup
ownership.consumer_reference_release: on the owned worker outside the protocol mutex, bounded cleanup ticket retains its subscription slot until final destructor return; included in stopped/closed condition
ownership.waiter_waker: clone, wake and final drop outside protocol mutex
ownership.wrapper_drop: Engine requests close; Operation requests cancel; Subscription requests stop; no blocking join

execution.sync_methods: caller thread for validation and admission
execution.production_host_and_sink: the engine-owned worker, never under protocol mutex
execution.self_drain: WouldDeadlock only when this engine worker directly polls its own wait; this is not cross-executor wait-cycle detection
execution.closure: stop admission, cancel operations, stop subscriptions, drain queued/inflight work and cleanup, then exit worker
execution.synchronous_callback_rule: Host/Sink may requestClose/requestStop and must return before an independent owner awaits closed/stopped/result; blocking waits on work that depends on the current callback are forbidden, including runBlocking or semaphore waits across an executor; the same restriction applies to foreign destructors

initialization.abi: version-matched UniFFI contract/version and per-symbol checksums
initialization.profile: MADB_PROFILE_DIGEST compiled identity compared before engine allocation
initialization.jvm_entry: openEngine(expectedProfile) -> uniffiEnsureInitialized() -> Engine constructor; raw UniFFI 0.32.2 constructor bypasses the upstream checksum initializer

test_support.async_foreign_owner: invoking consumer task plus explicit backend trampoline/cleanup acknowledgment
test_support.supported_lifts: generated thread-independent record/error/object lifting and lowering; no arbitrary custom converters
